summary_en: 13,238,900 shares to be cancelled (1.7% of shares outstanding). Effective date 2026-08-31. Post-cancellation shares outstanding: 780,314,008. Represents full cancellation of treasury stock held as of 2026-07-31.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: NEXON announced on 2026-08-13 that its board of directors resolved to cancel 13,238,900 treasury shares under Article 178 of the Companies Act of Japan. The cancellation represents 1.7% of shares outstanding as of 2026-07-31 and comprises all treasury stock held at that date. The effective date is 2026-08-31, after which issued shares outstanding will total 780,314,008 shares. No financial consideration is disclosed, as this is an internal capital transaction involving only already-held treasury shares.
